usage: The word "陽台" (joeng4 toi4) is a noun referring to the balcony of a home.
"陽台" can be used to describe a small outdoor space attached to an apartment or house.
It is often used with verbs such as "go to" (去), "clean" (清潔), or "stand on" (企) to talk about actions involving the balcony.
You can use "陽台" to ask questions about the location or size of the balcony, for example, "陽台有幾大？" (How big is the balcony?).
"陽台" is a common word in daily conversation related to housing and living spaces.
